headsmans_chop_skid_dust.dirs: flipX (drawn for a knockback to the right)

status: MOCKUP art, internal only - not wired into the game

direction.row_angle_deg: 22.5 * row, row 0 = east, clockwise on screen
direction.pick_row: row = round(atan2(aim_y, aim_x) / 22.5deg) mod 16 from the screen vector hero -> cursor
direction.placement: all dir16 strips spawn at the hero FEET (the swing plane is baked 8 px up, at the waist); hit_dir16 at each hit enemy's body centre (feet - 11 px), row = knockback direction; skid_dust at the enemy feet (flipX when pushed left)

visual_size.v1: arc outer radius 25 ground px, +-80 deg (1.6 u)
visual_size.v2: arc outer radius 56 ground px (3.5 u) = 2.24x, inner edge 16 px, +-85 deg around the aim; the cleave flash sits on the 56-61 px rim; sparks fly to ~75 px
visual_size.hitbox_note: Visual only. Suggested hitbox: a 170 deg sector, radius 56 px (3.5 u), checked on arc frame 2. HM sets the real hitbox.

layers.role: base smear: one solid crescent (thick bright head, thinning tail), white-hot leading edge and outer rim on f0-3, darker speed streaks inside, blood on the inner tail, a few flung blood drops; f0 wind-up sliver, f1 sweep, f2 full = DAMAGE frame, f3-7 erode from the tail and drift outward
layers.sort: ABOVE actors (+15) so it is not hidden by the enemies it hits

layers.role: flash: thin white/yellow crescent along the rim, 4 frames from arc f1
steel sparks thrown tangentially off the rim (22), 10 frames from arc f1
ground decal: the axe tip gouges the floor along the last 85 % of the arc (hot orange for 3 frames, cooling), 5 short scratches, fades by dither from frame 9
layers.material: alpha-clip decal + additive glow (hot pixels only)

layers.role: optional distortion: crescent pressure wave rolling out from r=30 to r=70 px over 9 frames
layers.material: screen-space distortion; uv offset = normalize(grad(blur(mask,1.5))) * mask * 2.5 art px

layers.role: per hit enemy: white star + 8 steel sparks + 5 blood flecks along the knockback
restrained debris: 6 small chunks (four 1 px, one 1.6, one 2.2) chipped out where the tip scrapes, short low hops, one small bounce, gone by f17
restrained dust: 3 small lumpy puffs (radius up to 3.4-4.4 px) at the scrape, v2c shading (banded, lit top-left, clump + ordered-dither break-up)
knockback skid: 2 tiny lumpy clouds trailing behind an enemy pushed right (flipX for left), replaces the v1 flat puff

glow_runtime: glow_rgb = blur(glow_mask.a / 255, sigma) * tint * gain, additive (One One), same frame + row as its sprite

timeline_frames_30fps.-5..-1: hero wind-up (t1517 melee strip); arc f0 one frame before the strike pose
timeline_frames_30fps.1: arc f1 sweep + flash f0 + sparks f0 + shock f0
timeline_frames_30fps.2: arc f2 FULL = DAMAGE: hit_dir16 f0 on every enemy hit, knockback starts (12 px over 6 f, ease-out), scrape decal f0
timeline_frames_30fps.2 (+2 hold): hit-stop: hold everything on arc f2 for 2 extra frames (67 ms)
timeline_frames_30fps.3-7: arc erodes; skid dust from hit+1 (40 ms frames)
timeline_frames_30fps.debris/dust: debris index = arc index, dust index = floor(t_ms/50) from arc f0
timeline_frames_30fps.end: scrape decal gone at ~0.9 s after the hit

v1_blood_wave: v1 headsmans_chop_blood_wave (bleeding enemies) is still valid and unchanged; not redone in v2
